original_local_audit.method: Actual full PNG and guide viewed. Frozen source coordinates transformed only by recorded display mapping. Visible lower material boundaries and side silhouettes manually read; selected pixel RGB probes distinguish material from blue/purple/orange/green guide strokes. Coordinates are image readings with roughly2.5..3.5px uncertainty, not survey measurements; no pixel file was changed.
key_findings: Tower front-edge y samples are near the source, but east masonry side extends about5..8px right of the source edge; southeast lower foot is about8px right. This lateral drift was not tested by the prior front-y-only samples.
South-gate front lower edge is about2..4px down/forward at sampled x, and its visible lower east side about5px to the right; back corners are hidden.
Hall central front ground edge is occluded by tower. Left exposed lower ledge corner lies about5px west of the published site-box corner; that box is not a new complete excavated hall footprint.
All seven wall source lines have only colored guide depictions here. No physical wall body, wall thickness or physical endpoint can be verified.

The gray outer tower-foundation frame is not a tower court or above-ground wall. Blue plinth projections are guide marks or occluded; source does not establish stairs, steps, ramps, rails or their heights.

Occluded segments show source position only; do not assign observed coordinates.

next_image_priority: Remove copied colored controls from artistic image while retaining an independent exact overlay.
Constrain tower southeast and east lower masonry extent to the source ring; also constrain south-gate east side and front edge. Do not translate source coordinates.

If plinth projections receive artistic material, keep their source footprints and avoid inferred steps, slope, rails or unsupported upper construction.

selected_reintegration_audit.summary: 回嵌 V3 已清除低处的重复旧门，适合作为三图中的全景预览展示；它尚未完成几何验收。塔身约九道叠檐可以辨认，南门仅一层门身清楚，不能确认三层。门基前缘仍比冻结位置低约 6–8 像素，塔与后殿下部也未能按来源基址分开核实。
findings: 原来位于约 y465–482 的重复旧南门已消失；当前只见一座较小的前置门，没有发现第二座低处旧门。
塔的中心约在 x516，叠檐仍约九道可辨；底部屋身与后殿形体交叠，无法据此独立确认塔基和后殿的完整轮廓。
南门主檐下只清楚显示一层可占用门身；细小的屋脊或屋面带不能算作另两层，因此三层门不通过可辨性检查。
门前接地边约 y459–460，冻结南前缘约 y452.4–453.3；在 x515 处约低 7.0 像素。可见门基约延至 x530–532，超过冻结东侧约 x522.6–523.3。
塔下可见一条较宽、连续的浅色台基前缘，约在 y435–436；它与后殿下部融合，不能把这条边直接认作完整且已配准的塔基。
七段来源墙线未能逐段对应到可辨认的实体墙端点。旧低处围墙及门前区被重绘，清理旧门不等于院墙位置通过。
全城、河流、桥梁与宫城的大构图仍可识别，但编辑框外约 99.992% 的像素发生变化，RGB 平均绝对差为 15.27/255；不能称为只改局部或框外像素不变。
remaining_limits: 新图是审查用回嵌预览，未成为第七次通过的全景，亦未批准替换首页。
9 道檐线的图像可辨性不证明建筑高度、结构或历史层数；当前门身不能确认三层。
源塔基、门基和后殿框仍沿用冻结 H；审查没有移动源环、拟合新 H、重设高度或把屋檐当作基脚。
低分辨率、下部形体融合和遮挡使部分基址边与角点无法可靠辨认；这些位置保持未核实，未把所有不重合点解释为遮挡。

method: Actually inspected the full V3 image and original trial-5 image; inspected read-only nearest-neighbour magnifications of native V3 pixels to distinguish roof bands, ground contacts and duplicated objects.

RGB difference uses PIL RGB arrays and absolute differences at identical native pixel coordinates. Only inclusive x442..594/y322..496 is excluded; no color normalization or resampling is applied.
